edges.label: contradicts
edges.reason: The figures are different (13% vs 23.7%). One is a low point, the other is current. They are incompatible as they describe different states of the same reservoir.

changes.sentence: On 2026-10-07, BBC reported “The use of pond water led to some recovery in reservoir levels, now at 23.7% full, but Green said islanders were simply "praying for rain".”; on the same day, BBC reported “Reservoir levels dropped to 13% at their lowest, forcing emergency shipments of water from the mainland to the 28 people who live on the island.”.
